extensionDescription.message: Save any page to the Koona Pin app on your computer in one click, and search your saved links from the browser.

commandSearch.message: Find a link in Koona Pin

searchKeys.message: ↑↓ · ↵ open · Shift ↵ here · Ctrl C copy

searchMore.message: The first $COUNT$ are shown. Add a word to narrow the search.

searchEmptyLibraryText.message: Click the Koona Pin button on a page to save it.

searchNothingText.message: Try another word, or search the whole library — the trash is never searched.

searchMissingText.message: Search goes to the Koona Pin library on this computer. Install the app — links you save wait here until then.

searchUpdateAppText.message: This Koona Pin saves links but can't search from the browser yet. Saving keeps working.

searchUpdateExtensionText.message: This extension doesn't match Koona Pin. Update it on the browser's extension page — saving keeps working.

searchLibraryText.message: Open Koona Pin to see why. Links you save wait here until then.

shortcutText.message: Opens the search over your library.

readingShortcutText.message: Saves the open page to Reading.

shortcutNote.message: $BROWSER$ changes extension shortcuts only on its own page, $PAGE$: the button opens it.

shortcutCancel.message: Esc to cancel. A shortcut needs Ctrl or Alt, not both.

shortcutInvalid.message: This key can't be a shortcut. Use Ctrl or Alt with a letter, a digit or F1–F12.

queueWaiting.message: Koona Pin: $COUNT$ waiting to be sent. Open the settings to see the queue.

badgeWaiting.message: Link is waiting to be sent to Koona Pin

badgeExisting.message: This link is already in Koona Pin

errorInvalidUrl.message: This page can't be saved. Open a page with an HTTP/HTTPS address.

errorUnsupportedScheme.message: This page can't be saved. Only HTTP/HTTPS links are supported.

errorUnavailable.message: Koona Pin didn't answer. The link will be sent again in a minute.

errorHostMissing.message: Koona Pin isn't installed or its installation is damaged. The link waits here.

errorHostForbidden.message: Koona Pin doesn't accept this copy of the extension. The link waits here.

errorIncompatible.message: The extension doesn't match Koona Pin. Update the extension — the link waits here.

errorIncompatibleApp.message: Koona Pin is older than the extension. Update Koona Pin — the link waits here.

errorInvalidRequest.message: Koona Pin can't save this link.

errorConflict.message: This request was already used for another link. Remove it from the queue.

errorDatabase.message: Koona Pin couldn't save the link. It will be sent again.

errorNoConfirmation.message: No confirmation that the link was saved

messageExistingText.message: Your tags and notes are unchanged

messageQueuedText.message: Will be sent when the app opens

menuReadingLinkNamed.message: Save link to Reading in Koona Pin

commandReading.message: Save page to Reading in Koona Pin

messageReadingQueuedText.message: Goes to Reading when the app opens

settingMessage.message: Show a message on the page

settingMessageText.message: A short note in the corner after you click the button. It leaves by itself after 3 seconds.

settingKnown.message: Show that a page is already saved

settingKnownText.message: The button checks every page you open against your library on this computer, while Koona Pin runs. The browser asks for access to your tabs once; addresses go only to the app.

settingAnimateText.message: The Koona Pin icon hops when a page is saved. It stays still when the system asks for less motion.

optionsLead.message: Pages you save go to the Koona Pin library on this computer.

statusClosedText.message: It starts in the tray when you save a page. Links wait here until then.

statusClosedTextMac.message: It starts in the menu bar when you save a page. Links wait here until then.

statusUpdateText.message: This extension ($MINE$) doesn't match Koona Pin $APP$. Update it in the browser's extension page — links wait here until then.

statusUpdateAppText.message: Koona Pin $APP$ is older than this extension ($MINE$). Update Koona Pin — links wait here until then.

statusMissingText.message: The extension can't find the app on this computer. Install Koona Pin, or reinstall it if it's already there.

statusForbidden.message: Koona Pin doesn't accept this extension

statusForbiddenText.message: Koona Pin is installed but doesn't know this copy of the extension. Install the extension from the Koona Pin download page — a development build works only with a development build of the app. Links you save wait here.

statusSandbox.message: Saving isn't available in this browser

statusSandboxText.message: The extension can't reach Koona Pin. Install Koona Pin if it isn't installed yet. If it is, this browser runs in a sandbox that keeps the app out — Flatpak, or Chromium from Snap: use the browser from your distribution's packages. Links you save wait here.

queueEmpty.message: Nothing waiting. Click the Koona Pin icon on a page to save it.

optionsFooter.message: Links stay in the browser until Koona Pin confirms them. If the app is closed, saving a page starts it in the tray.

optionsFooterMac.message: Links stay in the browser until Koona Pin confirms them. If the app is closed, saving a page starts it in the menu bar.
